title: 第1章 温堡奇事
content_zh:
“闵恩仇，‘曲池’、‘天枢’！”

    “秦英豪，‘地仓’、‘合谷’！”

    一个嘶哑的嗓子低声叫着，叫声中充满了怨毒和愤怒，语声从牙缝中蹦出来，似乎是千年万年永恒的诅咒，每个字音上都涂着血和仇恨。

    随着她的叫声，突突突突四声响，四道金光闪动，四枚金钱镖连珠发出，射向两块木牌。

    这两块木牌的正面反面都绘着同样的全身人形，一块绘的是个威猛粗豪的大汉，旁边写着“闵恩仇”三个字；另一块绘的是个高大瘦削的男子，旁边写着“秦英豪”三个字。人形上清楚注明人体周身穴道，木牌下接有木柄，两个身手矫健的壮汉各持一牌，在演武厅中快步奔走。

    大厅东北角一张椅子中坐着个五十来岁的白发老妪，口中喊着闵恩仇、秦英豪及人体穴道的名称。一个二十来岁的英俊青年劲装结束，腰间小包里带着十几枚金钱镖，听那老妪喊出穴道名称，他右手急扬，一道金光射出，钉向木牌。两个持牌的壮汉头上都戴着钢丝面罩，身上穿了厚棉袄，外面还罩着一件牛皮背心，手戴皮手套，唯恐那青年失了准头，金钱镖招呼到他们身上。两人蹿高伏低，摇摆木牌，要让他不易打中。

    大厅外的窗口，伏着一个妙龄少女、一个青年汉子，各自在窗户口往里窥视。两人见那青年身手不凡，暗器甚准，不由互相对望一眼，脸上都露出惊讶神色。天空黑沉沉的堆满了乌云，大雨倾盆而下，夹着一阵阵电闪雷鸣，势道吓人。黄豆般大的雨点落在地上，唰唰声响，直溅到窗外的两人身上。

    他们都身披油布雨衣，对厅内的事情很感好奇，又再凑眼到窗洞上去看时，只听那老妪说：“准头还将就了，就是没劲儿。今天就先练到这里吧。”说着慢慢站起来。

    那少女拉了那汉子一把，急忙转身，向外院走去。那汉子低声问：“这是什么玩意？”那少女说：“什么玩意？自然是练暗器了。这年轻人的准头算是挺不错的了。”那汉子说：“难道练暗器我也不懂？可是木牌上干嘛要写‘闵恩仇’、‘秦英豪’？”那少女说：“这就有点邪门。你不懂，我怎么就懂了？咱们问爸爸去。”

    这少女十八岁左右年纪，一张雪白晶莹的鹅蛋脸，眼珠黑漆漆的，两颊晕红，周身透着充满劲力的活泼青春气息。那汉子一张国字脸，比少女大着六七岁，神情粗犷，脸上生满紫色小疮，相貌有点丑陋，但步履轻捷，精神饱满，英气勃勃。

    两人穿过院子，雨越下越大，泼得两人脸上都是水珠。那少女取出手帕抹去脸上水滴，红红白白的脸蛋经水一洗，更显娇嫩。那汉子愣愣望着她，不由呆了。少女侧过头来，故意歪了雨笠，让笠上雨水顺着流入了他的衣领。那汉子看得出神，竟自不觉。那少女噗嗤一笑，轻轻叫了声：“傻瓜！”走进花厅。

    花厅东首生了好大一堆火，二十多人团团围着，在火旁烘烤给雨淋湿了的衣物。这群人身穿深色短打衣服，有的身带武器，正是一群物流公司的师傅们。厅上站着三名警员。这三人刚进来避雨，正在解去湿衣服，陡然见到这明艳照人的少女，不由眼前一亮。

    那少女走到烤火的人群中间，把一个身材略胖的老人拉在一旁，将刚才在后厅见到的事情悄声说了。那老人约莫五十来岁年纪，精神健旺，顶门微秃，头上略见花白，身高约莫一米六，目光炯炯，凛然有威。他听了那少女的话，眉头一皱，低声呵责：“又去惹是生非！若让人家知觉了，岂不自讨没趣？”那少女吐了吐舌头，笑着说：“爸，这趟陪你老人家出来运货，这可是第十八回挨你的骂啦。”那老人说：“我教你练功夫时，旁人来偷瞧，那怎么啦？”

    那少女本来嬉皮笑脸的，听父亲说了这句话，不禁心头一沉。她想起去年有人悄悄在场外偷瞧她父亲演武，父亲明明知道，却不说破，在试发袖箭时突然甩手一箭，将那人打瞎一只眼睛。总算是手下留情，劲道没使足，否则袖箭穿脑而过，那人哪里还有命在？父亲后来说：“偷师窃艺，武林大忌，可比偷窃财物更为人痛恨。”

    那少女一想，倒有些后悔，适才不该偷看别人练武，但姑娘家的脾气最是要强好胜，嘴上哪肯服输，嘟着嘴说：“爸，那人的暗器也平常得很，保管没人偷学。”老人脸一沉斥责：“你这丫头，怎么开口就说旁人的玩意不成？”那少女嘻嘻一笑说：“谁叫我是百胜拳岳老板的女儿呢？”

    三个在烤火的警员时不时斜眼瞟向那美貌少女，只是他父女俩说话很低，听不到说些什么。那少女最后一句话说得大声了，一警员听到“百胜拳岳老板”六个字，瞧瞧这个老人，又横着眼一扫插在厅口那枝蓝底黑丝线绣成的旗幡，鼻中“哼”了一声，心想：“百胜拳，嘿嘿，好大的口气！”

    这老人正是海安物流公司老板岳胜，江湖人称“百胜拳”。那少女是他女儿岳青，跟她一起偷看练暗器的汉子叫周银兵，是岳胜的义子。

    周银兵蹲在火堆旁烤火，见警员不住用眼瞟着妹妹，不由心头有气，向他怒目瞪了一眼。其中一警员刚好回过头来，跟他顿时对上了，心想：“你这小子横眉怒目干嘛。”也恶狠狠瞪了他一眼。周银兵本来就是霹雳火爆的脾气，见对方无礼，当下虎起了脸，直挺挺瞪着那警员。

    那警员约莫三十来岁，身高膀宽，一脸精悍之色。他哈哈一笑，向左边的同伴说：“你瞧这小子斗鸡儿似的，是你偷了他婆娘还是怎地？”两警员对着周银兵哈哈大笑起来。

    周银兵大怒，霍地站起来，喝道：“你说什么？”那警员笑吟吟说：“小子哎，我说错啦，我给你赔不是。”周银兵性子耿直，听到人家赔不是，也就算了，正要坐下，那警员笑着说：“我知道人家不是偷了你的婆娘，准是丢了你妹子！”

    周银兵一跃而起，扑上去就要动手。岳胜喝道：“小兵，坐下！”周银兵一愣，满脸胀得通红，叫道：“干爸，您……您没听见吗？”岳胜淡淡说：“警官们爱说几句玩笑话，又碍着你什么事了？”周银兵对干爸的话向来不敢违拗，狠狠瞪了那警员一眼，慢慢坐了下去。三警员又是一阵大笑，更加肆无忌惮地瞧着岳青，目光中满是淫邪。

    岳青见这三人无礼，要待发作，却知父亲素来不肯得罪公家，寻思怎么想个法子，跟这三个臭兵痞打一架。突然电光一闪，照得满厅光亮，接着一个焦雷，震得众人耳朵嗡嗡直响，这霹雳便像是打在厅上一般。天上就似开了个缺口，雨水大片大片地泼了下来。雨声中只听门口一人说：“这雨实在大得很了，只得借光在宝地避一避。”一名保姆说：“厅上有火，老板请进吧。”

    厅门推开，进来一男一女。男的长身玉立，器宇轩昂，背着一个背包，约莫三十七八岁年纪。女的二十三四岁，肤白胜雪，眉目如画，俨然是个绝色丽人。岳青本来算是美女，但这位丽人一到，立刻就被比了下去。这二人都没穿雨衣，那美妇身上披着那男子的外衣，已经全身湿透了。那男子携着美妇的手，两人神态亲密，似是对新婚夫妇。

    那男子找了一捆麦秆，在地上铺平了，扶着美妇坐下，显得十分温柔体贴。这二人衣饰华贵，美妇头上插着一枝镶珠的黄金凤头钗，那颗珍珠几乎有小拇指大小，光滑浑圆，珠光莹然，甚是珍贵。岳胜暗暗纳罕：“这一带道上很不太平，强贼出没。这对夫妻非富即贵，为何不带保镖，孤单单地赶道？”饶是他在江湖上混了一辈子，却也猜不透这二人的来路。
content_en:
"Min Enchou, 'Quchi', 'Tianshu'!"
"Qin Yinghao, 'Di Cang' and 'He Gu'!"
A hoarse voice screamed in a low voice, the scream was full of resentment and anger, and the words popped out from between the teeth, as if they were an eternal curse for thousands of years, and every word was smeared with blood and hatred.
Following her cry, there were four bursts of sound, four golden lights flashed, and four money darts were fired in succession, shooting towards the two wooden signs.
The front and back of these two wooden plaques are painted with the same full-body human figure. One depicts a powerful and rough man with the words "Min Enchou" written next to it; the other depicts a tall and thin man with the words "Qin Yinghao" written next to it.The acupuncture points all over the human body are clearly marked on the human figure. There is a wooden handle under the wooden sign. Two strong and strong men each hold a sign and run quickly in the martial arts hall.
Sitting in a chair in the northeast corner of the hall was a white-haired old woman in her fifties, calling out the names of Min Enchou, Qin Yinghao and the acupuncture points on the human body.A handsome young man in his twenties was dressed up and carrying a dozen money darts in a small bag at his waist. When the old woman called out the name of the acupuncture point, he raised his right hand and shot out a golden light, nailing the wooden sign.The two strong men holding licenses wore wire masks on their heads, thick cotton-padded jackets, and a cowhide vest, and leather gloves on their hands, lest the young man miss his mark and the money darts hit them.The two of them jumped high and low, swinging the wooden cards to make it difficult for him to hit.
At the window outside the hall, a young girl and a young man were crouched, each peering in from the window.Seeing that the young man had extraordinary skills and was very accurate with hidden weapons, the two couldn't help but look at each other with surprised expressions on their faces.The sky was dark and filled with dark clouds, and heavy rain poured down, accompanied by bursts of lightning and thunder, which was scary.Raindrops as big as soybeans fell on the ground, making a swishing sound and splashing onto the two people outside the window.
They were all wearing oilskin raincoats and were very curious about what was going on in the hall. When they looked at the window again, they heard the old woman say: "I'm pretty good at it, but I'm just not interested. Let's finish here today." She stood up slowly.
The girl grabbed the man, turned around quickly, and walked towards the outer courtyard.The man asked in a low voice, "What is this?" The girl said, "What the hell? Of course he is practicing concealed weapons. This young man's accuracy is quite good." The man said, "Don't I know how to practice concealed weapons? But why do they say 'Min Enchou' and 'Qin Yinghao' on the wooden sign?" The girl said, "This is a bit evil. You don't understand, how come I understand? Let's ask dad."
This girl is about eighteen years old, with a snow-white oval face, dark eyes, flushed cheeks, and a lively and youthful atmosphere full of energy.The man had a Chinese character face and was six or seven years older than the girl. He had a rough expression and his face was covered with small purple sores. He looked a bit ugly, but he walked briskly, full of energy and heroic spirit.
The two of them walked across the yard, and the rain became heavier and heavier, splashing water droplets on their faces.The girl took out her handkerchief and wiped the water droplets from her face. Her red and white face looked even more delicate after being washed with water.The man stared at her blankly, dumbfounded.The girl turned her head sideways and deliberately tilted the rain cover, so that the rainwater on the cover flowed into his collar.The man was so fascinated by it that he didn't realize it.The girl chuckled and called out softly: "Fool!" and walked into the flower hall.
There was a big fire in the east end of the flower hall, and more than twenty people gathered around it, baking clothes that had been soaked by the rain.This group of people were wearing dark shorts and some were armed with weapons. They were a group of masters from a logistics company.There were three police officers standing in the hall.The three people had just come in to take shelter from the rain and were taking off their wet clothes. When they suddenly saw this beautiful girl, their eyes lit up.
The girl walked to the middle of the crowd warming themselves by the fire, pulled a slightly fat old man aside, and whispered what she had just seen in the back hall.The old man was about fifty years old, energetic, slightly bald and slightly gray on his head. He was about 1.6 meters tall, with bright eyes and a commanding presence.After listening to the girl's words, he frowned and scolded in a low voice: "You are causing trouble again! If others notice, wouldn't you be asking for trouble?" The girl stuck out her tongue and said with a smile, "Dad, this is the eighteenth time I have been scolded by you when I accompany you to transport goods." The old man said, "When I was teaching you to practice Kung Fu, others came to peek, what happened?"
The girl was smiling playfully, but her heart sank when her father said these words.She remembered that last year, someone secretly watched her father perform martial arts from the sidelines. Her father knew clearly but did not tell anyone. When he was trying to fire the sleeve arrows, he suddenly shot an arrow and blinded the man in one eye.Finally, he was merciful and didn't use enough strength. Otherwise, if the arrow from his sleeve had passed through his head, how could that person still be alive?My father later said: "Stealing masters and skills is a taboo in martial arts, and it is even more hated than stealing property."
When the girl thought about it, she felt a little regretful. She shouldn't have peeped at others practicing martial arts, but the girl's temperament was very competitive. She was not willing to admit defeat. She pouted and said, "Dad, that person's hidden weapon is very common, and no one will steal it when he keeps it." The old man's face sank and he scolded: "You girl, why do you talk about other people's stuff?" The girl smiled and said, "Who told me that I am the daughter of the boss of Yum Sheng Quan Yue?"
The three police officers who were warming themselves by the fire occasionally glanced sideways at the beautiful girl, but the father and daughter spoke in a low voice and could not hear what they said.The girl said the last words loudly. When a police officer heard the words "Yum Sheng Quan Yue Boss", he looked at the old man and glanced sideways at the blue flag embroidered with black silk thread inserted at the entrance of the hall. He let out a "hum" in his nose and thought to himself: "Yum Sheng Quan, hehe, what a loud tone!"
This old man is Yue Sheng, the owner of Haian Logistics Company, known as "Yum Fist" in the world.The girl was his daughter Yue Qing, and the man who peeped with her to practice hidden weapons was Zhou Yinbing, who was Yue Sheng's adopted son.
Zhou Yinbing squatted by the fire to warm himself up. Seeing the policeman glance at his sister, he couldn't help but feel angry and glared at him.One of the police officers happened to turn around and faced him immediately. He thought to himself: "Why are you so angry?" He also glared at him fiercely.Zhou Yinbing always had a fiery temper. When he saw that the other party was rude, he immediately turned into a tiger and glared at the police officer.
The police officer was about thirty years old, tall and broad-shouldered, with a strong look on his face.He laughed and said to his companion on the left: "Look at this guy, he's fighting like a cock. Did you steal his wife or something?" The two police officers laughed loudly at Zhou Yinbing.
Zhou Yinbing was furious, Huo Di stood up and shouted: "What did you say?" The police officer smiled and said: "Boy, I made a mistake, I will apologize to you." Zhou Yinbing has an upright temperament. When he heard the apology, he let it go. Just as he was about to sit down, the police officer said with a smile: "I know they didn't steal your mother-in-law, they must have lost your sister!"
Zhou Yinbing jumped up and rushed forward to take action.Yue Sheng shouted: "Xiao Bing, sit down!" Zhou Yinbing was stunned, his face flushed, and shouted: "Godfather, you...didn't you hear?" Yue Sheng said lightly: "The police officers like to tell some jokes, what are they doing to you?" Zhou Yinbing never dared to disobey his godfather, so he glared at the police officer and slowly sat down.The three police officers laughed again and looked at Yue Qing more brazenly, their eyes full of lust.
Seeing these three people being rude, Yue Qing was about to get angry, but knowing that his father had never wanted to offend the public, he was thinking of a way to fight with these three scoundrels.Suddenly there was a flash of lightning, illuminating the entire hall, followed by a thunderclap that made everyone's ears buzz, and it was like a thunderbolt hitting the hall.There seemed to be a gap in the sky, and rain poured down in large areas.Amidst the sound of rain, only one person at the door said: "This rain is really heavy, so I have to take shelter in a precious place under the light." A nanny said: "There is a fire in the hall, boss, please come in."
The hall door opened, and a man and a woman came in.The man is tall and tall, with an impressive appearance. He is carrying a backpack and is about thirty-seven or eighteen years old.The woman was twenty-three or four years old, with skin as white as snow and picturesque features, making her a stunning beauty.Yue Qing was originally considered a beauty, but as soon as this beauty arrived, she was immediately compared to her.Neither of them were wearing raincoats. The beautiful woman was wearing the man's coat and was already soaked to the skin.The man held the hand of the beautiful woman, and the two looked intimate, like a newlywed couple.
The man found a bundle of wheat straw, spread it on the ground, and helped the beautiful woman sit down, looking very gentle and considerate.The two people were dressed in luxurious clothes. The beautiful woman had a gold crested hairpin inlaid with pearls on her head. The pearl was almost the size of a little finger, smooth and round, with a pearly luster, which was very precious.Yue Sheng secretly wondered: "The roads in this area are very unstable, and strong thieves are infested. This couple is either rich or noble, so why did they go alone without a bodyguard?" Even though he has been around in the world all his life, he still can't figure out the origin of these two people.
title_en: Chapter 1 The Curious Incident of Winburg
